verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 6.53
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 6.53

verses.pali: 5. Dhammikavagga
verses.english: 5. About Dhammika

verses.pali: Appamādasutta
verses.english: Diligence

verses.pali: Atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then a certain brahmin went up to the Buddha, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “Atthi nu kho, bho gotama, eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṁ, yo ca attho samparāyiko”ti?
verses.english: “Worthy Gotama, is there one thing that, when developed and cultivated, secures benefits for both this life and lives to come?”

verses.pali: “Atthi kho, brāhmaṇa, eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṁ, yo ca attho samparāyiko”ti.
verses.english: “There is, brahmin.”

verses.pali: “Katamo pana, bho gotama, eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato yo ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṁ, yo ca attho samparāyiko”ti?
verses.english: “So what is it?”

verses.pali: “Appamādo kho, brāhmaṇa, eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṁ, yo ca attho samparāyiko.
verses.english: “Diligence, brahmin, is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, secures benefits for both this life and lives to come.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, yāni kānici jaṅgalānaṁ pāṇānaṁ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṁ gacchanti; hatthipadaṁ tesaṁ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṁ mahantattena.
verses.english: The footprints of all creatures that walk can fit inside an elephant’s footprint. So an elephant’s footprint is said to be the biggest of them all.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, appamādo eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṁ, yo ca attho samparāyiko.
verses.english: In the same way, diligence is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, secures benefits for both this life and lives to come.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo sabbā tā kūṭaṅgamā kūṭaninnā kūṭasamosaraṇā, kūṭaṁ tāsaṁ aggamakkhāyati;
verses.english: The rafters of a bungalow all lean to the peak, slope to the peak, and meet at the peak, so the peak is said to be the topmost of them all.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa …pe….
verses.english: In the same way, diligence is one thing …

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, pabbajalāyako pabbajaṁ lāyitvā agge gahetvā odhunāti nidhunāti nicchādeti;
verses.english: A reed-cutter, having cut the reeds, grabs them at the top and shakes them down, shakes them about, and shakes them off.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa …pe….
verses.english: In the same way, diligence is one thing …

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, ambapiṇḍiyā vaṇṭacchinnāya yāni kānici ambāni vaṇṭūpanibandhanāni sabbāni tāni tadanvayāni bhavanti;
verses.english: When the stalk of a bunch of mangoes is cut, all the mangoes attached to the stalk will follow along.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa …pe….
verses.english: In the same way, diligence is one thing …

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, ye keci khuddarājāno sabbete rañño cakkavattissa anuyantā bhavanti, rājā tesaṁ cakkavattī aggamakkhāyati;
verses.english: All lesser rulers are vassals of a wheel-turning monarch, so the wheel-turning monarch is said to be the foremost of them all.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa …pe….
verses.english: In the same way, diligence is one thing …

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, brāhmaṇa, yā kāci tārakarūpānaṁ pabhā sabbā tā candassa pabhāya kalaṁ nāgghanti soḷasiṁ, candappabhā tāsaṁ aggamakkhāyati;
verses.english: The radiance of all the stars is not worth a sixteenth part of the moon’s radiance, so the moon’s radiance is said to be the best of them all.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, appamādo eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṁ yo ca attho samparāyiko.
verses.english: In the same way, diligence is one thing that, when developed and cultivated, secures benefits for both this life and lives to come.

verses.pali: Ayaṁ kho, brāhmaṇa, eko dhammo bhāvito bahulīkato ubho atthe samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati—diṭṭhadhammikañceva atthaṁ, yo ca attho samparāyiko”ti.
verses.english: This is the one thing that, when developed and cultivated, secures benefits for both this life and lives to come.”

verses.pali: “Abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama, abhikkantaṁ, bho gotama …pe…
verses.english: “Excellent, worthy Gotama! Excellent! …

verses.pali: upāsakaṁ maṁ bhavaṁ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṁ saraṇaṁ gatan”ti.
verses.english: From this day forth, may the worthy Gotama remember me as a lay follower who has gone for refuge for life.”

verses.pali: Ekādasamaṁ.
